# llms.txt

udpa-engine (github.com/jilimb0/udpa-engine) — Composite GitHub Action for Software Underwriting

udpa-engine (github.com/jilimb0/udpa-engine) is a reusable GitHub Action bundling the Gavel assay engine (v1) for continuous static due diligence, AST taint verification, and Ed25519-signed software passports in CI/CD pipelines.

## Usage

```yaml
- name: Run UDPA Software Assay
  uses: jilimb0/udpa-engine@v1
  with:
    path: '.'
    strict: true
```

## Related Systems

- **Gavel**: Autonomous software assay and capital underwriting platform ([gavel.sh](https://gavel.sh)).

## Links

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/jilimb0/udpa-engine)
